definition_en: To succeed in doing something after effort.
example_en: She achieved her goal of learning English.
example_uz: U ingliz tilini o'rganish maqsadiga erishdi.

definition_en: To agree that something is true although you do not want to.
example_en: He admitted that he was wrong.

definition_en: To tell someone what you think they should do.
example_en: The doctor advised him to rest.
example_uz: Shifokor unga dam olishni maslahat berdi.

definition_en: A strong wish to be successful.
example_en: Her ambition is to become a surgeon.

definition_en: Very old; from a long time ago.
example_en: We visited an ancient city.

definition_en: To say you are sorry for something.
example_en: I apologized for being late.

definition_en: To ask officially for a job or place.
example_en: She applied for a job at the bank.

definition_en: To speak angrily because you disagree.
example_en: They argued about money.

definition_en: The way you think or feel about something.
example_en: He has a positive attitude to work.

definition_en: Typical or normal; not special.
example_en: The average student studies two hours a day.
example_uz: O'rtacha talaba kuniga ikki soat o'qiydi.

definition_en: To stay away from something or someone.
example_en: Avoid sugar if you want to be healthy.

definition_en: To act in a particular way.
example_en: The children behaved well at the party.

definition_en: To be someone's property or part of a group.
example_en: This book belongs to my sister.

definition_en: A good or helpful result.
example_en: Exercise has many health benefits.

definition_en: Not afraid of danger.
example_en: The brave firefighter saved the child.

definition_en: To do something enjoyable for a special day.
example_en: We celebrated Navruz with the whole family.
example_uz: Biz Navro'zni butun oila bilan nishonladik.

definition_en: Something difficult that tests your ability.
example_en: Learning Chinese is a real challenge.

definition_en: An organization that helps people in need.
example_en: She gives money to charity every month.
example_uz: U har oy xayriyaga pul beradi.

definition_en: The people living in one area.
example_en: Our community built a new playground.

definition_en: To look at differences and similarities.
example_en: Compare these two phones before buying.
example_uz: Sotib olishdan oldin bu ikki telefonni taqqoslang.

definition_en: To say you are not happy about something.
example_en: He complained about the cold soup.

definition_en: Sure about your own ability.
example_en: She is confident about the exam.

definition_en: To make someone believe something.
example_en: He convinced me to join the club.

definition_en: The customs and beliefs of a group of people.
example_en: Uzbek culture is famous for hospitality.

definition_en: Wanting to know or learn about things.
example_en: Children are naturally curious.

definition_en: To harm or break something.
example_en: The storm damaged many houses.

definition_en: To earn something because of what you did.
example_en: You deserve a holiday after this project.
example_uz: Bu loyihadan keyin siz ta'tilga loyiqsiz.

definition_en: To grow or make something grow better.
example_en: Reading develops your imagination.

definition_en: Sad because something was not as good as expected.
example_en: We were disappointed with the result.

definition_en: To find something for the first time.
example_en: Scientists discovered a new planet.

definition_en: A feeling of not being sure.
example_en: There is no doubt about his talent.

definition_en: The energy you use to do something.
example_en: Success needs time and effort.
example_uz: Muvaffaqiyat vaqt va harakat talab qiladi.

definition_en: To give someone hope or confidence.
example_en: My teacher encouraged me to write.

definition_en: The natural world around us.
example_en: Plastic is bad for the environment.

definition_en: Completely necessary.
example_en: Water is essential for life.

definition_en: To think something will happen.
example_en: I expect the bus will be late.

definition_en: Treating everyone equally.
example_en: The referee made a fair decision.

definition_en: Happy to give more than is expected.
example_en: Our generous neighbour shares his fruit.

definition_en: The group of people who rule a country.
example_en: The government opened new schools.

definition_en: Something you do regularly.
example_en: Reading before bed is a good habit.

definition_en: Always telling the truth.
example_en: An honest answer is better than a nice lie.

definition_en: To become or make larger.
example_en: Prices increased last month.

definition_en: The power to change how someone thinks or acts.
example_en: Friends have a big influence on teenagers.

definition_en: To hurt a person or animal.
example_en: He injured his knee playing football.

definition_en: To create something completely new.
example_en: Who invented the telephone?

definition_en: Unhappy because someone has what you want.
example_en: He was jealous of his brother's new bike.
example_uz: U ukasining yangi velosipedidan rashk qildi.

definition_en: The information and understanding you have.
example_en: Knowledge is more valuable than gold.

definition_en: To succeed in doing something difficult.
example_en: She managed to fix the computer herself.

definition_en: To speak about something briefly.
example_en: He mentioned your name at the meeting.

definition_en: Worried or slightly afraid.
example_en: I always feel nervous before exams.

definition_en: What you think about something.
example_en: In my opinion the film was boring.

definition_en: A chance to do something good.
example_en: This job is a great opportunity for you.
example_uz: Bu ish siz uchun ajoyib imkoniyat.

definition_en: Able to wait calmly.
example_en: Be patient — the results come slowly.

definition_en: Damage to air water or land from harmful things.
example_en: Air pollution is a problem in big cities.

definition_en: All the people living in a place.
example_en: The population of Uzbekistan is growing.

definition_en: To stop something from happening.
example_en: Washing hands prevents illness.

definition_en: To say you will certainly do something.
example_en: She promised to call me tomorrow.
example_uz: U ertaga qo'ng'iroq qilishga va'da berdi.

definition_en: To keep someone or something safe.
example_en: Sunglasses protect your eyes.

definition_en: To suddenly understand something.
example_en: I realized I had left my keys at home.

definition_en: To say that something is good and worth trying.
example_en: Can you recommend a good book?

definition_en: To make something smaller or less.
example_en: We should reduce our screen time.

definition_en: To say no to something.
example_en: He refused to sign the paper.
example_uz: U qog'ozga imzo chekishdan bosh tortdi.

definition_en: A good opinion of someone because of their qualities.
example_en: Students show respect to their teachers.

definition_en: Having the duty to take care of something.
example_en: Parents are responsible for their children.

definition_en: People living together with shared rules.
example_en: Education makes society stronger.

definition_en: The answer to a problem.
example_en: We found a simple solution.

definition_en: To offer an idea or plan.
example_en: I suggest we start early.

definition_en: To help someone or agree with them.
example_en: My family supports my decision.

definition_en: To believe someone is honest and reliable.
example_en: I trust my best friend completely.

definition_en: Worth a lot of money or very useful.
example_en: Time is the most valuable thing we have.

definition_en: To use something badly or unnecessarily.
example_en: Don't waste water while brushing your teeth.
